GNB.note: The document states nothing on rules or an authority against AI harms.
The document says the payroll platform is not integrated with AI models; no AI in use in administration is stated.
No AI tool in a sector's public system is stated.
No AI model, dataset or AI computing built or hosted in the country is stated.
No digital-skills training for civil servants is stated.

facts.fact: The IMF mission chief and project lead say Guinea-Bissau launched a blockchain public payroll platform in May 2024 under its IMF ECF programme, which could track all 26,600 civil servants and 8,100 pensioners by November 2024.
The IMF project lead says the new blockchain payroll ledger platform was launched successfully in May 2024, after four years of work with the Fund and Ernst & Young.
